name: Morning inbox digest
description: A short summary of what arrived overnight and what needs a reply today.
instructions: Fetch the unread messages that arrived in the inbox in the last 16 hours (Gmail query `is:unread in:inbox newer_than:16h`), at most 40. Write a digest with three short sections: 1) Needs a reply today: one line per message (sender, subject, what they want). 2) Worth reading: one line each. 3) Everything else: one sentence with counts (newsletters, receipts, notifications). If the inbox is empty, say so in one line. Only read; never reply, archive or mark anything as read.
